sourceBasis.rule: All 180 certified v18 responsibilities remain regression/conservation baseline. This surface map adds current future disposition; it does not replace per-responsibility evidence. Each affected version must source-enumerate actual current DOM/routes/background consumers before G3 and reconcile complete coverage at G10.

surfaces.purpose: global product identity, notification and account actions
surfaces.notes: Flexible notification center; no page-specific toast owner.

surfaces.notes: Clear hierarchy; Data Health gets flexible explanatory space; informational status is not button-like.
Use canonical global processing; ticker-only is acceptable when density requires; no duplicate subscriptions.
Market Regime and Desk Control materially unchanged. Audit all other sections for duplication, decision value and progressive disclosure.

Preserve current Dashboard presentation unless a bounded defect is proven.

surfaces.purpose: market state, tradeability, what changed, evidence, contradictions and horizon relevance
surfaces.notes: Remove diagnostic plumbing from primary view; retain sourced evidence; consume canonical regime/contributors.
Preserve look/workflow. Remove only proven redundant/noisy projections; use canonical company name where primary ticker identity allows.
Preserve look/workflow; consume canonical symbol/evidence without duplicate processing.
Preserve look/workflow; short-lived event/flow evidence only where horizon-relevant.

surfaces.purpose: user interest and compact symbol intelligence
surfaces.notes: Separate user membership from Global Symbol Store; compact pattern/structure/event status only when material.

surfaces.purpose: identify what deserves attention now and move user toward a supported decision
surfaces.notes: Major-mover detection/admission/ranking/session behavior is a functional correction, not cosmetic redesign.

Add governed Global Symbols owner view; separate Owner-only from delegated Admin; no UI-only security.
Silent renewal when safe; truthful reauth/logout/revocation; cross-platform parity.
